footnotes: The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 36.5% to $1.2B in 2025. Operating income rose 2.2× to $589M, a 51.0% margin.
Net income rose 2.2× to $444M, or $3.36 per share. Operating cash flow was $797M and free cash flow $795M, versus $544M; Slide Insurance returned $40.0M through buybacks.
sources: Slide Insurance Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
